Description: Complete Normal or Veteran Group Dungeons while grouped with at least one other player.
Defeat world bosses while grouped with at least one other player.
Kill foes of any type while grouped with at least one other player.
Gather your allies and complete Trials.
Complete Undaunted Pledges bestowed by Urgarlag Chief-bane, Maj al-Ragath, or Glirion the Redbeard.
Finish battleground matches alongside a guildmate.

You can earn your crafting writ certification to qualify and then get to fulfilling writs today! Open the map, and look for the marketplace in most major cities across Tamriel. You'll find the crafting job boards nearby!
Harvest crafting resources from plants, ore, veins, or any other natural deposit.
